All keeps the text of a hidden element and template content

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, HiddenContent, convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { hiddenContent: HiddenContent.All };
  const result = convert("<p>visible</p><div role=\"tabpanel\" hidden>tab two body</div><template><p>row template</p></template>", options);
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
